resources.string: Surface
The raised body of cards and capsules: a hairline rim and one soft shadow that falls straight down.
A card. Rim, shadow, 9 dp of padding.
A flat card. It keeps the rim and gives up the shadow.
The same card, lifted. The body drew in a little to leave room for the shadow.
Lift the flat card
Lay it flat
Accent capsule
A coloured body sinks like a neutral one. Its colour does not change.
Track and thumb
A recessed bed filled with a hue, and the neutral thumb riding in it.
Rest
Pressed
At rest. The shadows under the track and the thumb are at full length.
Pressed. Both shadows tighten; no colour changes.
Well
A recess for text fields and media. A solid rim replaces the shaded one to show focus or an error.
Default: the rim shades from dark above to light below
Focus: an ink rim
Error: a danger rim
The shadow lives inside the view
A body draws its shadow within its own bounds, so the view is a little larger than the card the eye sees. The dashed line is the view.
Actual size
Four times
The gutter: 1.4 dp at the sides, 1 dp above, 4.8 dp below.
The bottom corner, four times larger. The shadow ends before the dashed line.
Split card
Two halves around a divider read as one card, and each can move or be hidden on its own.
Upper half: top corners, no shadow below.
Lower half: bottom corners, and the shadow of the whole card.
Fold the lower half away
Bring it back

Extracted from the original app: the raised surface, the track and its thumb, the well, the shadow gutter and the split card of its first-launch pages. New in Mallet: the primary capsule in the accent colour, the flat card, and the solid well rims for focus and error.
